sub_parameters.name: DagId

sub_parameters.name: NodeId

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:  
- **0**: task flow SLA rule.  
- **1**: task node SLA rule.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
